Rae: Idea: add a 'sentry fallback' variant for rollouts. It only routes requests flagged by heuristics (anomaly score, auth mismatch, or unknown prompt patterns) to a safe model instead of broad sampling. Keeps normal traffic untouched.
Tor: Nice. That reduces blast radius. Need explicit trigger set: anomaly_score > 0.8 OR prompt_pattern in denylist OR auth_level mismatch.
Mei: Important to make decisions deterministic and explainable. Suggest decision_id = HMAC(seed, request_id || anomaly_score) and a short reason_code like SNT_AUTH, SNT_ANOM, SNT_PAT.
Sam: UX: show a small gray 'sentry' badge on timeline. Panel should list reason_codes, sample_count, routed_count, and a compact histogram of anomaly scores. Also an 'Escalate to sample' action.
Rae: API sketch (concept only): fallback_mode: sentry, sentry_rules: [ {type:"anomaly",threshold:0.8}, {type:"pattern",denylist:[...]} ], route_when: reason in [SNT_*], billing: configurable (default: target), audit_sample_rate: 0.1.
Tor: Telemetry fields needed: fallback_mode, decision_id, reason_code, routed_boolean, anomaly_score (bucketed), prompt_hash, response_hash (sha256). Keep raw prompt out unless customer opts in.
Mei: Replay must be deterministic: record decision_id and use same seed for replays. Replay UI should allow running just the flagged request or a small batch of flagged requests side-by-side. No raw text by default.
Sam: Alerting: if sentry routed_count rises by >200% week-over-week or if a single reason_code produces >X% divergence we should notify SRE + product. Use stable alert codes to aggregate.
Rae: Operator actions: 'snooze sentry (1h/24h)', 'promote flagged -> sample', 'force-route all flagged to safe model'. All actions produce audit events requiring reason and operator id.
Tor: Implement detail: evaluation must be cheap at the edge. Compute anomaly_score using a tiny signature model or heuristics. Decision_id computed at edge and propagated.
Mei: Privacy: store only hashes unless explicit opt-in. Any stored artifacts require double-admin deletion. Document retention and opt-in flow in runbook.
Sam: QA: unit tests for decision determinism, e2e where anomaly spikes trigger sentry route, and integration for promote/snooze flows.
